Description: Hip power exercise. Hinge at hips, swing kettlebell between legs, then explosively drive hips forward to swing kettlebell to chest height.
Hip hinge pattern for glute strength and balance. Stand on one leg, hinge at hip, reach dumbbell toward ground while extending back leg.
Lateral power and deceleration. Jump laterally from one leg to the other, sticking the landing and controlling the movement.
Lower body strength and stability. Staggered stance, lower back knee toward ground while keeping front knee aligned over ankle.
Anti-rotation core exercise. Stand perpendicular to cable, press hands forward while resisting rotation from the cable tension.
Posterior shoulder and upper back strength. Pull rope attachment toward face, separating hands and squeezing shoulder blades together.
Improve rotational mobility in the thoracic spine. Quadruped position, one hand behind head, rotate through the mid-back while keeping hips stable.
Core stability exercise. Lie on back, arms extended up, knees at 90 degrees. Lower opposite arm and leg while maintaining lower back contact with floor.
Improve hip internal and external rotation. Sit with both legs at 90 degrees, lean forward over front leg, then switch sides.
Explosive rotation mimicking the golf swing. Stand sideways to wall, rotate and throw medicine ball against wall, catch and repeat.
Rotational power exercise. Pull cable from high to low or low to high across body with rotation, mimicking golf swing pattern.
Full body power exercise. Raise ball overhead, explosively slam down to ground engaging core and hips.
Core stability and coordination. From hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg, hold, then switch sides.
Improve rotational mobility. Sit with club across shoulders, rotate left and right while keeping hips stable and forward.
Improve ankle dorsiflexion. Face wall, drive knee forward over toes toward wall while keeping heel down.
Lower body strength and mobility. Hold weight at chest, squat down keeping chest up and knees tracking over toes.
Glute activation exercise. Lie on back with band around knees, drive through heels to lift hips while pushing knees out against band.
Upper back and posture strength. Lean back holding TRX, pull body up by squeezing shoulder blades together, keeping body straight.
Shoulder mobility drill. Hold band wide, bring arms up and over head to behind body in controlled motion, then reverse.
Explosive lower body power. Jump onto box from standing position, land softly with knees slightly bent.
Improve thoracic rotation with stable hips. Half kneeling position, rotate torso holding club across chest while keeping hips square.
Lateral hip strength and mobility. Step to side, sit hips back while keeping opposite leg straight, push back to start.
Forearm and wrist strength. Rest forearm on bench, curl weight up with wrist only, then perform extension.
Core stability against rotation. Stand perpendicular to resistance, hold at chest, press away and hold resisting rotation.
Upper body power. Hold ball at chest, explosively throw forward using chest and shoulders, catch and repeat.
Single leg strength and stability. Step up onto box driving through heel, extend hip and knee fully at top.
Core endurance and stability. Hold push-up position on forearms, maintain neutral spine without sagging or hiking hips.
Lat and upper back strength. Pull bar down to chest level, squeezing shoulder blades down and together.
Stretch hip flexors. Half kneeling position, drive hips forward while keeping upright posture and glute engaged.
Glute stability. Hold bridge position, alternately lift one knee at a time while maintaining level hips.

Exercise Name: Adductor Rock to Hip Walk Out
Description: Start on all fours, rock hips back to stretch adductors, then walk out to plank position. Combines adductor mobility with hip control.
Perform walking lunges with torso rotation toward front leg. Combines hip mobility with thoracic rotation in dynamic pattern.
Wide stance adductor position, rotate torso side to side. Combines adductor stretch with thoracic spine rotation.
Stand on one leg facing wall, rotate elevated leg in and out (hip airplane) while using wall for balance. Improves hip mobility and stability.
From standing pike position, rock weight forward to ankles and back to hamstrings. Improves posterior chain mobility.
Hold stick overhead with both hands, rotate thoracic spine left and right while maintaining stable hips and overhead position.

Exercise Name: Single Leg Hinge with T-Spine Rotation
Description: Hinge on one leg, reach down with one hand, then rotate torso and reach up with opposite hand. Combines hip stability with spinal rotation.
Perform single leg RDL while reaching hand toward wall. Combines hip hinge pattern with thoracic rotation and reach.
Sit in shin box position (90/90), rotate hips to switch sides while maintaining upright posture. Improves hip internal and external rotation.
Lateral squat pattern with continuous thoracic spine rotation throughout movement. Improves lateral hip mobility and rotation.
From push-up position, drive hips up into pike position. Combines shoulder mobility with hamstring flexibility.
Warrior stance with Pallof press, combining anti-rotation core work with hip position.
Various positions to mobilize glute tissue and improve hip range of motion through controlled movements.
Hold stick in Zercher position with staggered stance, emphasizing core control and thoracic position.
On hands and knees, alternate between arching back (cat) and extending spine (camel). Improves spinal segmental mobility.
From staggered stance, punch forward and grab into adductor stretch. Dynamic mobility combining upper body movement with hip stretch.
High load, low velocity rotational movement. Builds strength and stability as you rotate through swing pattern. Trains body to be stable under load.
Secure band behind you, lift one leg as if ascending stairs to activate core. Push band handles forward to extension. Strengthens core, chest, shoulders for swing control.
Medium weight, medium velocity. Toss weighted medicine ball against wall as hard as possible. Strengthens core and trains speed into swing.

Exercise Name: Split Stance Band Pulls with Rotation
Description: From staggered stance, pull band back like archer setting arrow, switching arms with rotation. Creates stability and strengthens back, biceps, thoracic spine.
Stand on one leg to engage stabilizers (ankle, knee, hip, glutes). Perform overhead or chest press. Recruits more muscle fibers than seated version.

Exercise Name: Single Leg Hip Abduction with Band
Description: Place band above knees, get into golf posture. Bend one leg back 90 degrees, abduct it out to side, return. Fires glutes independently for stability and balance.

Exercise Name: Side Plank Reach Through with Rotation
Description: From side plank, reach free arm up to sky, then rotate down through gap between body and ground. Core strength exercise prevents swaying and increases rotation power.
Hold club overhead or across chest, do lunge steps without back knee touching ground, add upper body rotation toward lead leg. Increases leg strength and spinal mobility.

Stand beside plyometric box, place near leg on box. Explosively drive through planted leg to propel body upward, simultaneously driving opposite knee up. Develops lateral hip power and dynamic stability to prevent lateral sway during the swing.

Lie on back, one leg extended. Explosively drive hips upward through planted foot, lifting hips as high as possible. Pause briefly at top, lower with control. Strengthens glutes and hips with explosive power for swing stability and force transfer.

Lateral explosive movement. Jump laterally from one leg to the other, landing softly and sticking the landing before bounding back. Trains lateral explosiveness and dynamic stability essential for powerful weight transfer in the swing.
Continuous single-leg hops focusing on minimal ground contact time and maximum height. Develops reactive strength and explosive power in each leg independently, improving ground force generation.

Explosive single-leg plyometric exercise. Start on one leg, explosively jump onto box, land softly with control. Builds explosive leg power and improves hip extension critical for ground reaction force in the golf swing.

Place rear foot on bench, explosively drive through front leg to jump upward. Land with control and repeat. Excellent for single-leg loading, stability, and explosive power. Can be performed with dumbbells for added resistance.
